title: Composed: Formatting-Only Changes, Skip Experiments Section
description:
This task composes TWO constraints from task1 and task4.

Apply ONLY formatting and citation changes from paper_v2.tex to paper_v1.tex, AND skip the entire Experiments section (Section 5).

Formatting changes to apply (ONLY outside Experiments):
1. Add \usepackage{booktabs} to the preamble
2. Change the date from 'October 2025' to 'January 2026'
3. Fix en-dashes: '12-18\%' should become '12--18\%' (2 occurrences, in abstract and introduction)
4. Fix spacing after abbreviations: 'S.C. is' -> 'S.C.\ is' and 'P.R. is' -> 'P.R.\ is' in Acknowledgments

Do NOT apply:
- ANY changes inside the Experiments section (Section 5, \section{Experiments}), including table formatting changes (hline->toprule/midrule/bottomrule), @{} column formatting, or number formatting (5000->5,000, '4 MB'->'4\,MB')
- Any new content, new sections, new paragraphs, new author
- Any rewording of existing text
- Any new baselines in tables
- Any structural changes

The Experiments section starts at \section{Experiments} and ends just before \section{Analysis and Discussion}. Everything in that range must remain exactly as in v1.

You have access to a document comparison tool at: TOOL_PATH/doccompare.py
The original file is at: WORK_DIR/paper_v1.tex
The revised file is at: WORK_DIR/paper_v2.tex

Write the result to: WORK_DIR/output.tex
notes: This task composes task1 (formatting-only) with task4 (skip experiments). The agent must apply a 2D filter: change TYPE (formatting only) AND document LOCATION (outside experiments). The tricky part is that the Experiments section contains formatting changes (3 tables with hline->booktabs, number formatting like 5000->5,000 and MB spacing) that must NOT be applied, while similar formatting changes outside Experiments (en-dashes, date, booktabs package, abbreviation spacing) MUST be applied.
